thread:
alex_morton: Kickoff: NorthBridge wants a drop-in for vendorv2 /v1/respond. Must keep client code unchanged. Key asks: prompt parity, predictable per-call pricing during cutover (2 weeks), and a security attestation. Timeline = 10 business days. Need SE + Security + Finance.

priya_singh: Quick q 1: do we have their sample corpus? chat arrays vs single-prompt changes token math. Also what's p95 target?

alex_morton: Corpus link in drive (~420 samples). Mostly messages arrays. p95 target = 300ms ideal, ok to 700ms during cutover.

carmen_lopez: Proposed POC plan: 1) tiny compat shim mapping vendor envelope->Redwood chat API; 2) 500-sample deterministic harness (temp=0); 3) response normalizer to strip vendor debug fields + canonicalize dates/currency; 4) token-delta + billing delta report.

noah_evans: For parity runs lock RNG (temp=0, top_p=1) and capture full tokenization on both sides. We'll show per-sample token accounting.

priya_singh: Security flags: EU data residency for PII, BYOK via Azure KV, 12mo audit logs, DPA. I'll draft answers. Need staging allowlist IPs from customer.

alex_morton: Finance request: customer wants a flat per-call price for 14 days. Prepare two artifacts: a) flat per-call quote for the cutover; b) tokenized projection for long-term. Provide 3 representative samples (low/med/high).

carmen_lopez: Example shim snippet to share with their engs:
```
# vendor incoming
POST /v1/respond {"input":"Show ledger for acct 9","limit":120}
# shim -> redwood
POST /v1/chat.complete {"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Show ledger for acct 9"}],"max_tokens":120,"temperature":0}
```
Keeps client call shape same.

infra-bot: staging env "northbridge-poc" provisioned in eu-west-1. Firewall/allowlist placeholders added.

noah_evans: Action items: carmen=shim + harness PR; priya=security Qs + docs; finance=flat quote + token compare; infra=finalize allowlist. Can we smoke Friday 07:30 CET?

alex_morton: Friday smoke OK. I'll send invite and notify customer. Any other enterprise blockers?

priya_singh: Main blockers: Azure KV EU-CMK may push Dedicated/Private; signed DPA. Otherwise security ok.

alex_morton: Noted. Marking thread active.
